card.capacity_status_quote: We have the Polaris Forge 1, Polaris Forge 2, and another site in North Dakota—three sites that we will be building through 2028 on all of those. That is going to take up a significant amount of the excess power that we see right now in North Dakota.
card.demand_direction_quote: We are seeing a clear acceleration in demand for high-performance AI data center capacity, as hyperscalers are as aggressive as we have ever seen them.
card.guidance_direction_quote: We remain confident in our ability to exceed our long-term goal of $1 billion of NOI within five years.
card.constraint_owner_quote: What that is really designed to do is to meet when we feel like we start to tap out of the available grid power, and then we are adding—Base Electron is adding—more power to the grid.
